tools.description: Lists all available upstream MCP servers with their IDs, names, and enabled status. Use this to discover which servers are available and their current state.
tools.name: portal_list_servers

tools.description: Initiates a server selection flow allowing the user to enable or disable upstream MCP servers. The user will be directed to a URL to complete the selection.
tools.name: portal_toggle_servers

tools.description: Toggles a single upstream MCP server on or off. Use 'toggle' to enable a server (will warmup and may require OAuth), or 'untoggle' to disable it.

action.description: 'toggle' to enable the server, 'untoggle' to disable it

server_id.description: The ID of the server to toggle. This is usually the prefix before tool names

tools.name: portal_toggle_single_server
